title: Ek Tara: Drives in Art, English and STEM · AquaTerra
description: AquaTerra's drives at Ek Tara since June 2021: Christmas workshops, Nature x English days, a dental camp and English teaching in 2026. {count} drives.
lede: Ek Tara has hosted AquaTerra drives since June 2021, when the first one was a pot painting workshop. Across {count} drives and {volunteers} volunteer turnouts up to {lastYear}, the work has moved from art and planting to Christmas workshops, public speaking and, in 2026, English teaching.

sections.heading: the early years
body: The first drives are a pot painting workshop on June 19, 2021, and a planting drive called Roots in Mud in late August 2021. Let's Talk Climate, a climate awareness workshop, followed at the end of August. The Roots in Mud drive planted 80 saplings.

In 2021 the Green Christmas drive had volunteers swap plastic for plants, crafts and conscious cheer. In 2022 the work went on with a Fun Fiesta mini fete in March, a Planet First Earth Day workshop in April, Smiles Shared in May, Paint The Pride art for Independence Day and Jolly Vibes at Christmas.

sections.heading: environment and English
body: Environment work has run through Ek Tara since 2021. For the Future, an Earth Day workshop in April 2023, taught children about conservation and sustainability, and the Color Club Green Diwali posters in October 2025 covered how firecrackers harm the environment.

The Nature x English days ran in June and July 2023: the first on June 16, the second on June 23 and the fourth on July 7. Volunteers used stories, leaves, poems and silence to teach English outdoors. Day 3 of the same series, on June 30, was held at Pather Sathi, so the series moved between places.

sections.heading: christmas and festive workshops
body: Christmas recurs at Ek Tara. Green Christmas came in December 2021, Jolly Vibes in December 2022 and Merry Miracles Day 1, a Christmas crafts workshop, in December 2023. In December 2024 the place hosted Tree Time and Deck the Tree, where children decorated a tree and made ornaments.

The largest volunteer turnout for one Ek Tara drive is Deck the Tree, on December 20, 2024. Tree Time, on December 13, covered the same craft a week before Deck the Tree, on December 20, so the two sit together as the December tree workshops at Ek Tara.

sections.heading: speaking, English and teaching
body: Speaking work runs through Ek Tara's sessions. Voice Power, a public speaking workshop, ran in May 2024, and Speech Ready followed in May 2025, introducing children to talking in front of an audience. Better Together celebrated friendship through art in June 2024, and Dad and Me made Father's Day gifts that month.

The 2026 sessions turn to English teaching. Sentence Secrets on April 4 taught subjects and predicates through worksheets. A Teaching Internship on April 18 taught nouns, pronouns and verbs, and a Teaching English Workshop on April 25 covered conjunctions and verbs. These are the most recent Ek Tara drives on this page.

sections.heading: other drives: staff, health and dental
body: Not every Ek Tara drive was for children. In October 2025 the Form assistance drive had volunteers help non-teaching staff with surveys, and thirty staff members were helped. The Color Club poster workshop ran in the same month. It is the only Ek Tara drive aimed at staff rather than children.

Dental drives ran in 2023. Tooth Talk in June described clean smiles, free checkups and tooth-care tips for those who needed them most, and the Say Cheese dental camp in October focused on oral hygiene among children. Who ran the checkups is not stated, so this page does not say. The Say Cheese camp and Tooth Talk were both 2023 drives, so dental work at Ek Tara sits in a single year.

learnings: Ek Tara has hosted AquaTerra drives since June 2021, the earliest of the places we keep going back to.
Christmas workshops recur at Ek Tara, the last one a tree decorating drive in December 2024.
The Nature x English days in 2023 moved between places, with Day 3 held at Pather Sathi.
The 2026 sessions are the only ones at Ek Tara about grammar, through a teaching internship and worksheet sessions.
The largest volunteer turnout for one Ek Tara drive was Deck the Tree in December 2024.

faqs.q: Is Ek Tara one of AquaTerra's regular places?
faqs.a: Yes. AquaTerra has run {count} drives at Ek Tara since June 2021, mostly children's workshops in art, public speaking, English and festive crafts.

faqs.q: When did AquaTerra first work with Ek Tara?
faqs.a: The first Ek Tara drive was Life in a Bottle, a pot painting workshop on June 19, 2021. Drives have continued there in every year since, through {lastYear}.

faqs.q: What English work has AquaTerra done with Ek Tara?
faqs.a: Ek Tara hosted Nature x English days in June and July 2023, public speaking workshops in May 2024 and May 2025, and English teaching in April 2026, including a teaching internship and a conjunctions and verbs workshop.

faqs.q: Which Ek Tara drive had the most volunteers?
faqs.a: Deck the Tree, an ornament making and tree decoration workshop on December 20, 2024, had the largest volunteer turnout of any single Ek Tara drive.

faqs.q: Did AquaTerra run dental camps for children at Ek Tara?
faqs.a: Yes, in 2023. Tooth Talk in June described clean smiles, free checkups and tooth-care tips, and the Say Cheese dental camp in October focused on oral hygiene among children.
